parts.name: Rotation Blade
parts.Basic_description: This is the rotation blade of a knife, made of stainless steel, typically sharp and metallic with a thin elongated shape.
parts.Functional_description: The blade is used for cutting, slicing, or piercing materials. It is the primary functional component of the knife.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate or fold relative to the base body in folding knives, but remains fixed in non-folding designs.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the base body or handle of the knife, made of durable plastic, ergonomically shaped for grip and control.
parts.Functional_description: The base body provides a comfortable and secure grip for the user, allowing safe and precise control of the blade.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary during use but may house a pivot mechanism for folding knives.
